title_en: Zheng Chuanzhen v. Nanping Intermediate People's Court — criminal compensation case
keywords_en: state compensation; criminal compensation; retrial; High People's Court; Fujian Province; natural person; State Compensation Law; retroactive effect of the State Compensation Law; whether partial retrial amendment constitutes wrongful detention; compensation for erroneous judgment continuing after 1995; partial support; erroneous conviction of theft; retrial amendment to partial acquittal; detention for 1,638 days; principle of compensation for wrongful detention; theft
full_text_en:
Zheng Chuanzhen v. Nanping Intermediate People's Court — Criminal Compensation Case

Compensation Petitioner: Zheng Chuanzhen, male, 53 years old, native of Fuqing City, Fujian Province, formerly the person in charge of the forwarding depot at Shaowu Shaikou for the state-owned Beidou Forestry Harvesting Farm of Taining County, Fujian Province.

Agent ad litem: Wu Yexing, lawyer of Taining County Law Firm.

Compensation Obligor: Nanping Intermediate People's Court, Fujian Province.

Legal Representative: Xu Zhicong, President.

Compensation Petitioner Zheng Chuanzhen, dissatisfied with the decision of Nanping Intermediate People's Court, Fujian Province, to refuse state compensation, filed an application for reconsideration with Fujian High People's Court.

Compensation Petitioner Zheng Chuanzhen alleged: The original judgment of Nanping Intermediate People's Court imposed a combined punishment for several offenses. Although the retrial did not acquit me of all charges, it found that the crime of theft was not established and revoked that conviction. With respect to the crime of theft, I am innocent. Pursuant to Article 15, paragraph (3) and Article 19 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, Nanping Intermediate People's Court should revoke its decision to refuse compensation and grant compensation according to law.

The Compensation Committee of Fujian High People's Court, upon trial, found the following facts:

On May 14, 1991, Shaowu People's Court rendered a first-instance criminal judgment: It found that in November 1988, defendant Zheng Chuanzhen purchased 25.932 cubic meters of logs without a license at a price of RMB 400 per cubic meter, then resold them to Fengtai County Wood Products Factory, Anhui Province, at RMB 500 per cubic meter, altering the quantity of logs to 29.035 cubic meters, thereby profiting RMB 4,148.30. This constituted the crime of speculation, for which he was sentenced to one year of fixed-term imprisonment. On December 27 of the same year, Zheng Chuanzhen sold 33.142 cubic meters of miscellaneous timber stacked at Shaowu Shaikou Depot owned by the Township Construction and Building Materials Company of Jianyang Prefecture to Fengtai County Wood Products Factory, Anhui Province, constituting the crime of theft, for which he was sentenced to seven years of fixed-term imprisonment. Combining the punishments for the two crimes, the court decided to execute a total of seven years and six months of fixed-term imprisonment (the term of imprisonment commencing from October 30, 1989 to April 29, 1997); the illicit gains of RMB 42,992.16 were to be recovered and returned to the Township Construction and Building Materials Company of Nanping Prefecture; the illegal income of RMB 2,124.89 and the amount of RMB 1,331.60 recovered from Fengtai County Wood Products Factory were to be confiscated and turned over to the state treasury. Zheng Chuanzhen, dissatisfied with this judgment, filed an appeal. On July 22, 1991, Nanping Prefecture Intermediate People's Court rendered a second-instance criminal ruling: The appeal was dismissed and the original judgment was affirmed. Fujian High People's Court conducted a retrial of this case under the trial supervision procedure. The retrial held that the fact that Zheng Chuanzhen engaged in the resale of timber was true and constituted the crime of speculation. The original judgment, without completely excluding the possibility that Zheng Chuanzhen had mistakenly sold the timber, found that Zheng Chuanzhen, in collusion with Pan Guoming, had stolen and sold the timber. This was clearly insufficient evidence, and the judgment that Zheng Chuanzhen committed the crime of theft was improper and should be corrected. Accordingly, on March 15, 1995, Fujian High People's Court rendered a retrial criminal judgment: It affirmed the portion of the original judgment sentencing Zheng Chuanzhen to one year of fixed-term imprisonment for the crime of speculation and the recovery of his illicit gains; it reversed the portion of the original judgment sentencing Zheng Chuanzhen to seven years of fixed-term imprisonment for the crime of theft.

On April 24, 1995, Zheng Chuanzhen was released from Jianyang Prison, Fujian Province. He had been detained for 1,638 days due to the erroneous conviction.

On June 15, 1995, Compensation Petitioner Zheng Chuanzhen filed an application for compensation with the Compensation Obligor, Nanping Intermediate People's Court, claiming that he had suffered losses due to the erroneous conviction for theft, and requesting compensation for losses from detention due to the erroneous conviction, return of the amounts recovered as illicit gains, and return of the goods and cash seized by the public security organs. Nanping Intermediate People's Court held that the State Compensation Law came into effect on January 1, 1995. The Supreme People's Court, in its Reply on the Retroactive Effect of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China and the Scope of Cases Accepted by the Compensation Committees of People's Courts (hereinafter referred to as Fa Fu [1995] No. 1 Reply), stipulated that the State Compensation Law does not have retroactive effect. The case of Zheng Chuanzhen was adjudicated before the implementation of the State Compensation Law and therefore the provisions of the State Compensation Law are not applicable. Moreover, Article 15, paragraph (3) of the State Compensation Law provides that compensation is available only if "a person is acquitted of the crime by a retrial conducted in accordance with the trial supervision procedure, and the original sentence has already been executed." The retrial criminal judgment of Fujian High People's Court only reversed the original conviction for theft but did not acquit Zheng Chuanzhen. Therefore, Zheng Chuanzhen did not fall within the scope of state compensation, and the court decided to refuse compensation.

The Compensation Committee of Fujian High People's Court held that:

The provision in Fa Fu (1995) No. 1 Reply that the State Compensation Law does not have retroactive effect means that if acts taken by state organs or their personnel in exercising their powers infringed upon the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, or other organizations, and those acts occurred and ended before December 31, 1994, the State Compensation Law shall not apply, and the laws in effect at the time of the acts shall govern. In this case, the retrial on March 15, 1995, reversed the portion of the original judgment convicting Zheng Chuanzhen of theft. Zheng Chuanzhen was erroneously convicted of theft and was detained until April 24, 1995, when he was released. Although the infringement caused by the erroneous judgment occurred before January 1, 1995, the infringing act continued until after January 1, 1995. Therefore, for that part of Zheng Chuanzhen's criminal compensation application that is compensable after January 1, 1995, the State Compensation Law shall apply and compensation shall be granted. For that part compensable before December 31, 1994, for which there were no provisions at that time, the State Compensation Law may also be applied by reference.

Criminal compensation under the State Compensation Law implements the principle of compensation for innocent detention. Only unlawful detention that meets the requirements of the State Compensation Law can lead to state compensation. The provision in Article 15, paragraph (3) of the State Compensation Law should be understood as referring to specific individual crimes. Although the retrial judgment of Fujian High People's Court in Zheng Chuanzhen's case did not acquit him of all charges, it revoked the portion of the original judgment sentencing Zheng Chuanzhen to seven years of fixed-term imprisonment for the crime of theft. The retrial did not change the conviction because the circumstances of Zheng Chuanzhen's alleged theft were so minor that the act was not deemed a crime; rather, the original judgment was based on unclear facts and insufficient evidence, such that the crime of theft was fundamentally not established. The situation also does not fall under the state exemption from liability provided in Article 17 of the State Compensation Law. Since Zheng Chuanzhen's conviction for theft has been reversed, the executed sentence has lost its lawful basis and constitutes an infringement. Therefore, Zheng Chuanzhen has the right to obtain state compensation according to law.

Article 26 of the State Compensation Law provides: "Where personal freedom of a citizen is infringed, the daily compensation shall be calculated according to the average daily wage of employees of the state in the preceding year." Pursuant to Article 6 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning People's Courts' Implementation of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, the amount of the state's average daily wage for the preceding year shall be calculated by dividing the annual average wage of employees by the number of legal working days in the year. As for the part of Zheng Chuanzhen's detention loss incurred before December 31, 1994, it shall also be compensated by reference to the provisions of the State Compensation Law.

In conclusion, although the original conviction for theft was reversed and the case did not result in an acquittal on all charges, Zheng Chuanzhen has the right to apply for and obtain state compensation for the sentence executed due to the crime of theft. Among the recovered illicit gains and property, RMB 3,456.49 was profit from the crime of speculation. Since this crime was not reversed, the illicit gains cannot be returned; RMB 42,992.16 was the proceeds from Zheng Chuanzhen's sale of timber belonging to the Township Construction and Building Materials Company of Nanping Prefecture and should be returned to the owner. Zheng Chuanzhen's application for return of the recovered illicit gains and property is unreasonable and is not permitted. Nanping Intermediate People's Court, as the court that rendered the original effective judgment, shall bear compensation liability according to law. The other compensation claims raised by Zheng Chuanzhen do not meet the requirements of the State Compensation Law and are not supported. The Compensation Committee of Fujian High People's Court rendered the following decision:

1. Nanping Intermediate People's Court's decision to refuse compensation is revoked;

2. Nanping Intermediate People's Court shall compensate Zheng Chuanzhen RMB 16,501.12;

3. Zheng Chuanzhen's application for the return of the recovered illicit gains and property is dismissed.
